faq: A free mod for a clearer Minecraft Java server list. Discover public servers and manage favorites, notes, groups and your own addresses in Horizon.
Horizon 2.1.0 is available as a native .hnmod, tested on Windows x64. Fabric and Forge 2.2.0 are available as public beta JARs for Minecraft Java 26.3 / Java 25. Choose the download for your loader.
Do I rebuild at every launch?
No. Horizon builds native mods into a client once, then reuses that build. Changing the mod file or the enabled mod set requires a new build.

guide_intro: Download Server Atlas for Horizon, Fabric or Forge. Minecraft Java 26.3, public server discovery, filters and favorites. Free and open source.
guide_steps: Get server-browser-2.1.0.hnmod. It contains the native Rust implementation for Horizon, rather than a Fabric or Forge .jar.
Open that instance's game folder and put the file in horizon-native-mods. Keep an older Server Atlas package backed up outside this folder.

On the launcher's Mods page, switch server_browser 2.1.0 on. Choose the ordinary Build action for the tested revision and review the mod list. The player decides whether to accept “I trust these mods: build”.
Wait for the build to finish, close the older client and start this exact instance. Open Multiplayer. A mod update requires a new native build; normal launches reuse it.
guide_help: An installed file may still be switched off. Turn on server_browser in the selected instance's Mods page.
The running client was built without this version. Finish the native build and restart the resulting instance.
Use the ordinary Build action with the package's exact pins. The separate latest-Nightly rebuild can override them. Other mods may require different revisions; test this mod alone first.
native_notice: Native mods run with your user permissions. The first build downloads tools and can take several minutes. Your own Minecraft resources are required and are not distributed with the mod.
project_intro: Server Atlas makes the path from searching to playing together shorter. Here is the current release, its sources and its data behavior.
project_sections: An independent community project developed for shuab. The native Horizon 2.1.0 package is MIT licensed, includes its Rust sources and targets Minecraft Java 26.3. Tested on Windows x64. No separate host patch or companion program is required.
Public beta: 96 automated checks passed per loader. Some installation and gameplay combinations remain unverified. Horizon: 44 Rust tests; pinned native build.

The dated catalog combines 488 previously researched addresses with 2,347 additional unique public Java addresses from Modrinth, for 2,835 total. Serverify's public documentation identified the additional source; this is an independent API integration.

minecraftserve.rs and Modrinth have separate five-minute caches and a persistent limit of one public request per source per minute. Search text, personal servers, notes and player names are not sent to the directory APIs. Existing explicit Off remains Off. Normal status checks contact servers directly.

Search and filters run in your browser. A shareable search may appear in the URL and hosting request logs. The site's own code has no analytics, advertising scripts or external fonts. Clipboard access is used when you choose Copy address.

All product images are unedited captures of the built mod. Example profiles contain invented personal servers and notes; the discovery image is a real online test. Minecraft, Horizon and modloader names belong to their respective owners. The Server Atlas compass icon is original AI-generated artwork, exported for the platform icons. Product screenshots are real game captures.

java_guide_intro: Minecraft 26.3 · Java 25. Use a separate instance for each loader.
java_steps: Install Fabric Loader 0.20.1+ or Minecraft Forge 66.1.5+ for Minecraft 26.3.
Download the matching Server Atlas JAR and place it in that instance’s mods folder. Remove older Server Browser JARs there.
Start Minecraft and open Multiplayer. The browser opens automatically; Classic returns to the original screen.
